passages.excerpt_preview: ing Piyadasi, beloved of the gods, having been consecrated twenty years, came himself and worshipped, because the Buddha Sakyamuni was born here.
When he had been consecrated fourteen years, King Piyadasi enlarged the stupa of the Buddha Konakamana; when he had been consecrated twenty years, he came himself and worshipped.
